description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Empowerly provides college and career counseling supported by data-driven technology. The Full Stack Software Engineer builds and improves software for counselors and operations, spanning React interfaces, backend services, APIs, databases, and AI-powered features.
Full Stack Software Engineer building React and backend/API/database features, including LLM-powered tools, and debugging production systems

Responsibilities:
• Solve the real problem behind a request from counselors, operations, or product
• Ship tested, full-stack features end to end: React, backend services, APIs, and the database underneath
• Build and improve AI-powered features using LLMs and AI APIs, and check whether they help the people using them
• Turn ambiguous requests into a scoped plan and a working first version quickly, then iterate on feedback
• Debug production issues across the stack, with a senior engineer at first and on your own over time

Requirements:
• Experience shipping software that other people use, from a job, internship, freelance work, open source, or a substantial project of your own. We care about what you built and your role in it, not how long you have been doing it
• Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, networking, and how the web works. This usually means a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, EECS, or a related field, or equivalent depth you can show us
• The ability to sketch a simple system design for a feature, explain the tradeoffs, and go into detail when asked
• Solid React and TypeScript, with strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals
• Working knowledge of the backend: APIs, databases, and third-party integrations
• Hands-on experience using AI APIs or LLMs inside an application, beyond using AI coding assistants to write code
• Comfort with Git, code review, and writing tests
• A methodical approach to debugging: you find the root cause instead of guessing
• Clear communication: you can explain technical decisions to people who are not engineers, and you follow problems through to done

Preferred:
• Experience building Agentic AI workflows
• Experience building internal tools or working directly with non-engineering teammates or customers
• Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD
• Time at a startup or in a fast-moving environment
